mapper.sql: id, user_id, kind, name, title, author, url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO sources () VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{name}, #{title}, #{author,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{url}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, url) WHERE kind = 'WEBSITE' DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, title = EXCLUDED.title, author = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.author, sources.author), updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sources src WHERE src.id = #{id} AND src.user_id = #{userId} AND src.kind = 'FILE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saves s WHERE s.source_id = src.id)
mapper.sql: SELECT src.id AS source_id, count(*) AS saves_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'HIGHLIGHT') AS highlights_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'CLIP') AS clips_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'IMPORT') AS imports_count, min(s.created_at) AS first_saved_at, max(s.created_at) AS last_saved_at FROM sources src JOIN saves s ON s.source_id = src.id AND s.user_id = src.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE src.user_id = #{userId} AND src.id = #{id} GROUP BY src.id
SELECT s.source_id, s.color FROM saves s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.color IS NOT NULL AND s.source_id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.source_id, s.color ORDER BY s.source_id, count(*) DESC, s.color

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.source_id) s.source_id, s.text, s.color FROM saves s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.color IS NOT NULL AND s.source_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.source_id, s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT s.source_id, n.id AS note_id, n.title, count(*) AS quotes_count FROM note_blocks b JOIN notes n ON n.id = b.note_id JOIN saves s ON s.id = b.save_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND s.source_id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.source_id, n.id ORDER BY s.source_id, n.updated_at DESC, n.id DESC
SELECT id FROM sources WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND search_vector @@ to_tsquery('simple', ari_unaccent(#{prefixQuery}))
SELECT src.kind AS kind, count(*) AS count FROM sources src WHERE src.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saves s WHERE s.source_id = src.id AND s.user_id = src.user_id) GROUP BY src.kind
